description: Canonical cross-reference contract for connecting legal authorities, cases, legislation, people, institutions, evidence, history, and analysis.
rules: Never infer a substantive legal relationship solely from shared keywords.
Preserve the source that establishes each relationship.
Do not upgrade indexed or analytical relationships to verified without review.
Allow one record to have multiple relationships to the same target when each has independent provenance.
Keep legal authority, empirical evidence, historical context, and analytical interpretation distinguishable in presentation.
